name: Membership renewal and lapse list
summary: Once a month the membership coordinator gets one list from the member export: who is due to renew, who is in the grace period, who has lapsed since the last run and which records need fixing, with a renewal reminder and a lapsed-member note drafted for each level. A person checks and sends everything.

sources.title: FullyPowered AI's own original writing on membership renewal work for associations and member-funded organizations.
